item.title: Event: Shi Fu Miz Festival 2026 – line-up and peek at the new eco-park venue
item.description: Shi Fu Miz Festival is returning next month for a new edition at Tai Tong Ecopark in Yuen Long. item.title: Hong Kong Federation of Students to disband after 68 years, citing ‘increasing pressure’
item.description: The Hong Kong Federation of Students has announced plans to disband after 68 years in operation, citing “increasing pressure.” Isaac Lai, chief representative of the HKFS, told HKFP over the phone on Thursday that the group held a standing committee meeting on Thursday morning to vote on initiating the dissolution process.
